images.caption: Picture of the 1906 Officer Staff of the Porto Rico Regiment now known as the 65th Infantry Regiment. It should be noted that on January 15, 1899, the military government changed the name of Puerto Rico to "Porto Rico". On 30 June 1901, the "Porto Rico Provisional Regiment of Infantry" was organized. On May 17, 1932, U.S. Congress changed the name back to "Puerto Rico".
